errors.text: The proposed falsification experiment tests whether extended sintering promotes HCP formation, not whether hardness originates primarily from grain refinement rather than solute strengthening. Grain size and composition/phase effects are not independently varied.
The specified 500 g Vickers load differs by about an order of magnitude from the target 0.05 kN load, and the hypothesis omits the requested quantitative strain or displacement-rate operating regime.
The asserted HCP stability threshold above 1100 °C is unsupported by the cited evidence and does not reproduce the relevant boundary at which densification saturates near 1000 °C.
